desc: Implement the complete Python solution using an implicit two-layer Dijkstra over states (vertex, parity), with original adjacency for parity 0, reversed adjacency for parity 1, toggle edges of cost X, and output min(dist[N,0], dist[N,1]).
Ensure the implementation uses 64-bit integer distances, efficient adjacency storage, and stale-entry checks in the priority queue for N, M up to 2e5.
Verify correctness on the provided samples and edge cases, including large X and answers exceeding 32-bit range.
